Our client is seeking candidates who can join their team immediately. To apply, please submit your application via the relevant job boards.

Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

job.title: Mortgage Collections Officer | hybrid
job.description:
The Company…..
Our client is a highly regarded specialist lender with an established presence across Australia and New Zealand. Known for flexible home loan solutions and a customer first philosophy, they support customers whose financial circumstances sit outside traditional lending models.
The culture is collaborative and supportive, built on integrity, teamwork and service excellence. Leaders are approachable and experienced, and committed to positive outcomes for both customers and employees.

The Job…..
A permanent opportunity is available in the Sydney CBD office, with an immediate start or four weeks’ notice both welcome.
Reporting to the Collections Manager, you will manage a portfolio of consumer mortgage accounts 30 to 90 days in arrears. The role calls for a balanced approach: achieving strong recovery outcomes while treating every customer with empathy and respect.

Key responsibilities include:
  • Contacting customers about overdue accounts and recovering arrears in a professional, respectful manner
  • Negotiating and implementing realistic repayment arrangements tailored to each customer’s circumstances
  • Monitoring repayment plans and following up on commitments
  • Working with Customer Service, Credit and Legal teams to resolve matters efficiently
  • Maintaining accurate records and complying with internal processes and regulatory requirements
  • Meeting individual KPIs while contributing to a collaborative, high performing team
You…..
To be successful, you will bring:
  • A minimum of 18 months’ collections experience in financial services, mortgage collections experience is preferred, however for the right candidate training can be provided
  • Confidence when handling sensitive conversations about overdue accounts
  • Strong negotiation and influencing skills
  • Excellent attention to detail and organisation
  • A proactive mindset and the ability to integrate quickly into an established team
How to apply….
If you bring genuine empathy and are seeking a long term permanent role with a well regarded financial services organisation, we would love to hear from you. Email your CV to jquigley@sbrecruitment.com or call Jenny on 02 9002 5005 for a confidential conversation.

job.title: Employee Relations Specialist | NSW Government
job.description:

 A well-regarded organisation is seeking an experienced People & Culture Business Partner, Case Management for a short-term contract through to 20 December 2026. This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on HR professional with strong employee relations experience.

The role operates in a high-volume, complex case management environment, requiring sound judgement, autonomy and the ability to manage sensitive and high-risk employee matters.


The Job…..
As a People & Culture Business Partner, Case Management, you will be responsible for the following duties:
  • Manage complex employee relations matters end to end, including grievances, workplace complaints, conduct and underperformance.
  • Manage health, wellbeing and fitness-for-work matters, particularly non-work-related injuries.
  • Provide practical, risk-balanced advice in line with legislation, policies and procedural fairness.
  • Prepare accurate and defensible documentation, correspondence and case records.
  • Partner with managers, P&C specialist teams and stakeholders to resolve matters effectively.
  • Exercise sound judgement and discretion when handling sensitive and contentious issues.
  • Prioritise multiple cases concurrently while meeting tight deadlines.

You…..
To be successful in this role, you will have experience in the following areas:
  • Demonstrated experience independently managing complex and sensitive employee relations cases in a high-volume environment.
  • Experience within government or a highly regulated environment is strongly preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of employment legislation, industrial instruments and public sector policy frameworks.
  • Proven ability to apply procedural fairness and manage risk in contentious matters.
  • Experience in employee relations, industrial relations or workers’ compensation case management.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement, communication and documentation skills.
  • The ability to work autonomously, exercise sound judgement and deliver from day one.
  • Confidence navigating digital tools and Microsoft Office applications.

How to apply…..
Don’t miss this opportunity to work for a company that really looks after its people! Please send through your CV via our website.

job.title: Account Manager | Commercial Asset Finance | Sydney
job.description:
The Company
SB Recruitment is proud to partner with Vestone, a specialist asset finance business with more than 25 years of industry expertise.
  
Formed through a joint venture between Macquarie Group and Mitsubishi HC Capital, Vestone provides tailored funding solutions across healthcare, education, government and professional services. Combining strong institutional backing with specialist expertise, the business has an established client base and continues to grow across the Australian market.

The Role
This is a relationship focused Account Manager position responsible for managing and growing an established portfolio of brokers, vendors and customers.
  
You will build strong client relationships, drive retention and identify opportunities to grow existing accounts through renewals, facility increases and broader funding solutions. Acting as a key point of contact, you will also work closely with internal teams to resolve issues and ensure a high level of customer service.  There is also a business development component, with the opportunity to leverage your industry networks and market knowledge to introduce new customers to Vestone.
  
Key responsibilities include:
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with brokers, vendors and customers
  • Manage an established portfolio, driving retention and customer engagement
  • Identify opportunities to grow accounts through renewals, facility increases, upselling and cross-selling
  • Support the onboarding of new customers
  • Work with internal teams to resolve issues and deliver strong customer outcomes
  • Monitor portfolio performance and manage customer reviews and renewals
  • Maintain accurate customer and pipeline information within the CRM
  • Generate new business opportunities through networking and lead generation
About You
You will bring experience within asset finance, equipment finance, commercial lending or a related financial services environment, together with a strong track record in managing and developing client relationships.

To be successful in this role, you will also demonstrate:
  • Minimum 5 years experience in business development, account management or relationship management within the commercial asset finance sector
  • Tertiary qualifications in finance, business, commerce or a related discipline will be highly regarded
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Commercial acumen and the ability to identify opportunities within existing accounts
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • A proactive and self motivated approach
How to apply
This is an excellent opportunity to join an established and growing asset finance business, manage a strong existing portfolio and play a key role in developing Vestone’s customer relationships and continued growth.
Apply via the link or contact Jenny or Sarah on 02 9002 5000 for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Risk Analyst | Enterprise Risk, Compliance and Advisory
job.description:
The Company…..
A well established Australian financial services business with multiple licensed entities is entering its next phase of growth. The risk, legal and compliance function is evolving to a true enterprise risk model. The team reports directly into the board and has a clear governance mandate. You will join a group of solid, hard working people with deep experience across lending, settlements and originations.

The Job…..
This is an analyst level role with a strong advisory leaning. You will sit at the centre of the team's regulatory, assurance and reporting work, turning complex obligations into clear and practical insight for the business and the board.
  • Prepare and support ASIC reporting, and help the business understand what the requirements mean in practice
  • Synthesise information from across the business into clear insight and reporting for senior stakeholders
  • Support licensing, obligations management, assurance and advisory projects
  • Work with the data and insights capability in the team, understanding how data comes together, including IDR and EDR reporting
  • Contribute to a team that is looking to leverage AI and analytics to lift the quality of risk reporting
  • Partner with colleagues across assurance, internal audit, AML and fraud, and collections quality assurance
You…..
  • Hands on ASIC reporting experience, with the ability to interpret regulatory requirements in a commercial setting and not just in theory
  • A good working knowledge of the Australian regulatory landscape for lending and credit, including collections and hardship
  • A background in risk, compliance, assurance, advisory or internal audit within financial services
  • Comfortable working with data, reporting tools and metrics, and confident presenting insights clearly
  • Able to thrive in an environment with a high level of change, and to bring a practical, solutions focused approach
  • Strong communication skills and the confidence to engage with stakeholders at all levels
How to apply…..
If you're an analyst with ASIC reporting experience who can turn regulation into practical commercial insight for the board, this is a chance to shape a risk function as it moves to an enterprise model. Apply via the link or contact Jenny on 02 9002 5005 for a confidential conversation. All applications are treated in the strictest confidence.

job.title: Finance Customer Service - graduates welcome!
job.description:
The Company
Since 1980, this privately owned Australian gold bullion business has built a strong reputation buying and selling investment options for a loyal client base. Today it is growing, stable and ready to welcome an enthusiastic, adaptable people person to its Client Services team. If you love helping people face to face and you’re ready to learn a new industry from the ground up, this is your chance.

The Opportunity
If you are a Customer Service superstar who genuinely lovely helping people and have a genuine interest in the financial service markets, this could be your next step:
  • Comprehensive, structured training provided, with no prior finance experience required
  • A great launchpad for early career candidates from customer service, concierge, venue, hospitality, retail or front of house backgrounds
  • Consistent hours of 8.30am to 5pm Monday to Friday, with no weekends or late finishes
  • The security of a stable, privately owned business with real momentum
  • A growing company means real scope to build specialist knowledge and move up as the team expands
The Role
You’ll be the friendly, confident face of the business, the person clients remember. Every day is different, and you’ll be right at the centre of it.
  • Welcome new clients and guide them through opening their account, with a smooth and professional experience from the very first conversation
  • Look after client sales and purchases from start to finish, so people feel confident and well looked after every step of the way
  • Be the go to voice for clients and stakeholders on inbound and outbound calls
  • Support high value transactions with accuracy and care, and see the real impact of your work
  • Work within established procedures and regulatory requirements, building a strong understanding of compliance and ethical business practice
  • Manage account opening and closing to a consistently high standard
  • Pick up projects with the Operations Manager as your skills and confidence grow, giving you a window into how the whole business runs
  • Learn an exciting, specialised industry with full training and support behind you
About You
To be successful in this role ideally you will have:
  • Up to two years’ experience in a customer facing role such as customer service, concierge, venue, front of house, hospitality, retail or similar, or you’re just starting out and keen to prove yourself
  • A real people person with a positive, energetic attitude and a passion for exceptional service
  • Excellent client skills, with a friendly, professional manner and the confidence to stay calm and helpful with demanding clients
  • Clear, confident communication, both face to face and over the phone
  • Adaptable, comfortable with change, and quick to pick up new systems and processes
  • A great fit for a close, collaborative team, with a supportive attitude and a genuine investment in shared success
  • Curious and eager to learn, with an openness to building a career in finance
  • Good organisation and written communication skills
  • A proactive, can do mindset and the willingness to take on responsibility
How to Apply
If you’re ready to bring your enthusiasm to a business that values service, integrity and career growth, we’d love to hear from you. Contact Jenny Quigley on 02 9002 5005 or jquigley@sbrecruitment.com for a confidential conversation.

This is not an entry-level or trainee position — it requires someone with genuine jewellery manufacturing experience who can read a job with a jeweller's eye and make sound production calls.

You will be responsible for the following duties:
  • Reviewing and interpreting client product briefs, drawing on your own manufacturing knowledge to assess what's actually required.
  • Identifying and obtaining any missing technical or production information directly from clients.
  • Translating client requirements into a clear, comprehensive manufacturing brief.
  • Determining and coordinating the most appropriate production pathway — whether local bespoke manufacturing, offshore production, laser cutting, hand fabrication, or coin pressing.
  • Allocating CAD work to internal and external drafting resources.
  • Coordinating communication between customers, CAD drafters, CAM operators, and production teams.
  • Monitoring job progress, following up on revisions, approvals, and production timelines.
  • Maintaining accurate job records and documentation within internal systems.
  • Identifying opportunities to improve workflow efficiency and support continuous process improvement.
You
This role is suited to an experienced jeweller looking to transition from a hands-on bench role into a broader operational or project coordination position — leveraging your industry expertise while advancing your career. To be successful, you will bring:
  • A solid, demonstrated background in jewellery manufacturing.
  • The confidence to interpret technical specifications and make informed production pathway decisions based on real manufacturing knowledge.
  • Strong computer and administrative skills, or a genuine willingness to build on them.
  • Strong organisational and time management skills with the ability to coordinate multiple jobs simultaneously.
  • Excellent communication and relationship building skills, with the confidence to liaise with customers, contractors, and internal stakeholders.
How to Apply
This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced jeweller to step into a varied and rewarding coordination role within a supportive, collaborative team. To apply, submit your application to jquigley@sbrecruitment.com or contact Jenny Quigley on 02 9002 5005 for a confidential discussion.
